name: oes-partner-pipeline
narrative: Zara runs supply for Komadugu Health Initiative, which operates eleven therapeutic feeding sites across Borno. They know their caseload precisely, because they admit the children — and today they know almost nothing about the supply they depend on. This is that inverted. Inbound consignments arrive in the frame Komadugu actually plans in: a distribution day, at a named site, with a known number of children expected, each one reading as covered, at risk, or uncovered. From what has physically arrived and the rate they are admitting, each site shows its weeks of cover and the date it runs dry — the difference between planning and triaging admissions. When a truck arrives short, the storekeeper counts it and records the receipt themselves, and the shortfall becomes a discrepancy raised by the person holding the cartons rather than an argument between head offices. When cover will not last, Zara raises a shortfall signal from this screen, and it lands in the OES command centre as the exception their team acts on. And because Komadugu's own workers already screen every child they treat, a received batch can be followed forward — to the distributions it fed, and to one child's arm circumference climbing out of the red.

zara.intro: Zara plans distributions for eleven therapeutic feeding sites and is the person who decides, when supply is short, which site gets what. Today they learn a consignment is late when the truck fails to arrive, find out what was really in it by counting cartons on a loading bay, and report a shortfall by telephoning someone in Abuja. Their own organisation is the only one touching both the carton and the child, and it is the one with no instrument to show it.
zara.name: Zara Mustapha

features.description: An org kind discriminator (supplier or implementing_partner) on the existing org model, plus a partner role in roles.py and rbac.py mirrored in perms.js, so membership, auth and tokens stay single-path.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply/tests/test_rbac_contract.py still asserts perms.js equals ROLE_PERMS with the partner row present; test_demand.py::test_a_partner_cannot_reach_procurement_surfaces.

features.description: Partner orgs own their distribution_hub and delivery_point nodes and link to the caseload each site serves.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply/tests/test_demand.py::test_a_partner_sees_only_their_own_sites — another organisation's delivery points are absent from the payload, asserted like the gov country scoping.

scenes.narrative: Everything a central team sees looks outward. Turn it around. Komadugu Health Initiative runs eleven feeding sites in Borno. They know their caseload to the child, because they are the ones admitting them — and they know almost nothing about the supply they depend on. They learn a consignment is late when a truck does not arrive. They find out what was in it by counting cartons on a loading bay. And they report a shortfall by telephone. They are also the only organisation in this entire chain that touches both the carton and the child, which makes them the one positioned to prove the supply chain worked, and the one with no instrument to do it.
scenes.title: The organisation that feeds the children sees the least

features.description: A DistributionPlan per site node and date, carrying expected children and cartons required, rendered as a calendar with inbound consignments joined onto it. The covered / at risk / uncovered state resolves on the SERVER, so the calendar cannot disagree with the cover projection about the same Tuesday.

scenes.narrative: A shipment table sorted by arrival date is a supplier's view of the world. Zara's unit of planning is a distribution day, at a named site, with a known number of children expected — so that is the frame the inbound supply is shown in. Monguno has five hundred and forty-eight children booked and nine hundred cartons on hand: covered. Askira has fifty-nine booked against thirty-eight cartons, and ninety-four more are on the road — arriving after that distribution, so they do not cover it. That is why a cell can be amber with a lorry already on the way, and why adding the two numbers together would tell Zara the opposite of the truth. Biu has a hundred children booked and nothing on hand at all. Three states, on the grid, in the shape they already think in.
scenes.title: Inbound supply, in the calendar they plan in

features.description: Per-site stock on hand from receiving events, a weekly burn rate from the caseload the site serves, and from those weeks of cover and a projected stockout date — literally the same server-side derivation the command centre uses (services/cover.py), scoped to the partner. One implementation, not two agreeing ones.

scenes.narrative: From what has physically arrived and the rate they are admitting children, every site shows two numbers: how many weeks of cover it is holding, and the date it runs dry. This is the figure that changes behaviour. At four weeks of cover you plan. At one week you start triaging admissions, which is a decision nobody wants to make quickly or quietly. Kukawa is eleven days out. Knowing that three weeks early is the entire point, and no partner in this sector currently gets it as a live number.
scenes.title: Weeks of cover, and the date it runs dry

features.description: Partner-side receipt capture at the check-in tier, with its webform equivalent, raising a Discrepancy when the count fails to reconcile against the ASN and shipment lines — now attributable to a receiving partner org, which had no representation in the model when this was first written.
features.verify: test_execution.py asserts the webform and API doors produce identical records; a short receipt raises a Discrepancy attributed to the receiving partner org.

scenes.narrative: A truck has reached Monguno and nobody has counted it yet, so the consignment sits on Zara's receiving screen waiting for a number. The storekeeper counts what came off it and records the receipt: the advice said nine hundred cartons, and eight hundred and forty are on the floor. The discrepancy does not have to be raised — it exists the moment the count is recorded, because the app reconciles the count against the despatch advice itself. And it is recorded by the person standing next to the pallets, at the store, which is what the record says. A shortfall asserted from a capital city is a dispute. The same shortfall counted at the loading bay against the advice that was sent with the truck is evidence.
scenes.title: The storekeeper counts it, and the short count is evidence

features.description: A ShortfallSignal raised from the partner surface carrying site, date, children affected, cartons short and a note, resolvable by a SupplyAction.

scenes.narrative: Kukawa will not last. Zara raises a shortfall from this screen: the site, the date, the children affected, the cartons short. It does not go into a message queue somebody may or may not read — it lands in the OES command centre ranked against every other exception by the children behind it, and marked as raised by Komadugu rather than derived centrally. The direction is what matters here: the ground reporting upward into a system that can respond, rather than the centre reporting downward about the ground. What OES does with it is the next narrative.
scenes.title: Zara raises a shortfall, and the centre answers

features.description: A DistributionRecord per site, date and partner org, carrying cartons dispensed, children served, and the batch lot traced back to a ShipmentLine — synthesised inside supply, keeping the app's zero cross-app-import boundary intact.

A ChildOutcome with an anonymised identifier, admission measurement, a per-visit measurement series, discharge status, and the batch lot it was treated on, rendered against the WHO red/amber/green MUAC bands and labelled synthetic on screen. Discharges are seeded to the Sphere performance band (recovery above 75%, defaulting below 15%) so the series and the discharge status cannot disagree.

scenes.narrative: Komadugu's own workers already screen every child they treat, and that record and the supply record have never been the same chain. Joined up, they are. Zara opens a batch that arrived last month and follows it forward — to the distributions it supplied, to the children admitted on it, and to one child whose arm circumference climbs across their visits out of red, through yellow, into green. Recovered. This is the linkage the funding standards describe and the sector achieves as far as the contract and then abandons. The last mile here is synthetic and says so; the point is that both ends of it already exist and can be held as one record.
scenes.title: From a batch to the child who recovered
